mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates sustained monetary accommodation, reducing discount rates applied to equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 4.0% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering economic slowdown expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion regime (INDPRO > 105 and CPIAUCSL > 2.5), industrial production growth and inflationary pressures trigger Federal Reserve tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 105 and CPIAUCSL > 2.5 (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained year-over-year decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening residential demand, reducing consumer confidence and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST declines year-over-year (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly Consumer Price Index increase exceeding 0.2% signals accelerating inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening expectations and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL monthly change > 0.2% (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate labor market contraction, reducing household income and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market collapse regime (HOUST < 1800 thousand units and RSAFS declining), residential sector stress reduces consumer spending and financial sector stability, generating negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1800 and RSAFS declines (t-test p-value > 0.05 for mean return < 0).
